verified_facts.text: The hotel is located directly in the Elbphilharmonie.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel is directly located in the Elbphilharmonie.

verified_facts.text: Guests reach the concert hall through a revolving door on the hotel's 8th floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: visit the iconic concert hall for an unforgettable concert by just going through a revolving door on the 8th floor of the hotel

verified_facts.text: The Elbphilharmonie building was designed by Swiss architects Herzog & de Meuron.
The Elbphilharmonie is built on a historic warehouse and crowned by glass.
verified_facts.excerpt: Built on a historic warehouse and crowned by glass reflecting sky and sea

verified_facts.text: Rooms look through the curved glass facade over the port city.
verified_facts.excerpt: Through the curved glass facade of our unique hotel, take in the urban panorama of Germany's most famous port city.

verified_facts.text: Premium Waterfront rooms look out on boats and cruise ships passing on the Elbe.
verified_facts.excerpt: Watch small boats and large cruise ships passing by on the Elbe from our Premium Waterfront rooms

verified_facts.text: The puristic interior design is inspired by water, sand and wind.

verified_facts.text: Classic rooms do not have a view of Hamburg or the harbor; they face the atrium.

verified_facts.text: The Heavenly Spa has an indoor pool with natural daylight above Hamburg's port.
verified_facts.excerpt: Swim with a view in our 20-meter indoor pool with natural daylight above Hamburg's port.

verified_facts.text: The spa has Finnish and bio saunas and steam baths.
verified_facts.excerpt: Six treatment rooms, Finnish and bio saunas, plus two steam baths create a calm space to unwind.

verified_facts.text: Hotel guests have complimentary access to the day spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Recharge at our day spa—hotel guests enjoy complimentary access

verified_facts.text: A Private Spa Suite offers a private whirlpool, sauna and steam bath.

verified_facts.text: Fang & Feld serves North Sea fish and produce from the Altes Land near Hamburg.

verified_facts.text: BLICK Bar on the 8th floor serves cocktails with views of HafenCity and the Elbe.

verified_facts.text: A tipi is available for kids under six.

verified_facts.text: Families get exclusive pool times with water toys.
